records.tagline: YouTube & YT Playlist Length Checker
records.description: Check and calculate YouTube & YT playlist length instantly with our free online checker and calculator tool. Check total duration at 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x speed and plan your watch schedule.

records.name: Ludo Quest
records.tagline: Ludo with friends, Sudoku and crosswords in one Android app
records.description: Bring everyone to the table with 2–6 player Ludo, computer opponents and team play. Switch to Sudoku with guided hints or 36 original crosswords. Play locally offline or invite friends to private online rooms. Free on Android, with ads. By quabe.

records.name: Quzzle
records.tagline: Offline word, number and block puzzles for everyday breaks
records.description: Make a little room for play: connect words in Wordoku, solve number patterns in Matrix, type through Word Rain and clear blocks in Rangofall. Explore 1,200 levels in each learning game, plus a vocabulary notebook. Offline puzzles, no account needed. Free on Android, with ads. By quabe.

records.name: Glammer
records.tagline: Creative Asset Library and a reimproved design system.
records.description: An AI React UI builder with a built-in creative asset library of cinematic images, gradients, icons and logos. Edit on a canvas and export a runnable project.

records.name: daubee
records.tagline: Checks unit-consistency in Excel spreadsheets
records.description: Daubee, a unit checker for Excel. Contribute to psteckler/daubee development by creating an account on GitHub.

records.name: Wektor
records.tagline: Wektor is a local-first data analysis desktop app
records.description: Wektor is a local-first data analysis desktop app. Upload a CSV or connect a database, and it writes analysis code from a schema summary alone, then runs that code locally, against your full data. Row-level data never leaves your machine.

records.name: Chip Builder
records.tagline: Puzzle game where you build a working CPU from logic gates
records.description: ChipBuilder is a story driven puzzle game about digital logic. Start with a single AND gate and work your way up through registers, memory, and a full ALU, until you have wired together a working CPU with your own hands.

records.name: Chatdek
records.tagline: AI Chatbot & AI Receptionist for Business Websites
records.description: Chatdek is an AI chat widget for business websites. It answers visitors from your own business information 24/7, books appointments inside the chat, captures leads and hands conversations to your team, all managed from one portal.

records.name: GenMusic AI
records.tagline: AI Music Generator for Songs, Scores, and Background Music
records.description: GenMusic is an AI music generator for prompt-to-music, lyrics-to-song, and background soundtrack workflows.

records.name: HeadshotForma
records.tagline: AI Headshot Generator for Professional Headshots
records.description: Create professional headshots with AI for LinkedIn, business profiles and websites. Explore four styles and one-time packages from $19.

records.name: GasTracker
records.tagline: Track lowest gas fees and execute smart swaps securely
records.description: GasTracker is a lightweight decentralized Web3 tool that helps crypto users track lowest network gas fees in real-time and execute smart swaps efficiently. Featuring a smart routing system, it prioritizes the best fees to maximize your savings while integrating seamlessly with popular wallets like MetaMask and Trust Wallet. Optimize your DeFi transactions and save on every trade.

records.name: ChatSequel - ChatGPT Auto Continue
records.tagline: Auto-continue ChatGPT replies and hand off long chats
records.description: ChatSequel is a free Chrome extension that auto-sends your chosen continuation after ChatGPT replies in enabled tabs. HANDOFF summarizes accessible chat content to help continue in a new chat. Pause, resume, and control each tab independently.

records.name: blare
records.tagline: Open-source error alerting for Python and Node.js
records.description: Error alerting in two lines. No server, no dashboard, and one message per problem instead of 847. Captures your existing logs, crashes and framework 500s, strips secrets, and posts to Slack, Discord or Teams. Python and Node.js, Apache-2.0.

records.name: SmartFoodAdvisor
records.tagline: AI meal ideas from your pantry to your shopping list
records.description: A German-language AI food coach for everyday cooking and shopping. Start with ingredients you have, get recipe ideas, plan meals and collect missing items in a shopping list. Free entry: up to five AI requests once per account. Optional Master plan: EUR 4.99/month incl. VAT. No paid subscription starts automatically.

records.name: zenkAI
records.tagline: AI tutor and study plan for every exam
records.description: Study through new eyes. zenkAI turns your materials and goals into a concrete study path.

records.name: Lanes
records.tagline: Keeps your team's coding agents from overwriting each other
records.description: When several people on a team run coding agents in the same repo, the agents overwrite each other's work. Lanes is a free VS Code extension for Claude Code teams. It shows every teammate's agents and the files they're editing, live. When two agents need the same file, one waits a moment, picks up the other's change and carries on. No edit is refused and no work is lost. Working alone? It runs with zero setup.

records.name: Boltori
records.tagline: A thrifty little chipmunk who lives on your PC
records.description: Boltori is a hand-drawn chipmunk that lives on your Windows desktop. Click and it hops with both arms up, rub its belly, drag it around. Double-click and its cheeks fill up with acorns. Its eyes follow your mouse. It never reads what you type and never sends anything online.

records.name: Humanity Pixel
records.tagline: Your own numbered place in a shared human grid
records.description: Claim your Pixel, discover your unique number and make your profile your own. Explore a shared grid and the profiles people choose to make public. Humanity Pixel is an early-stage project built around personal presence and discovery.

records.name: Video Editor for Large Files, No Sign Up
records.tagline: A full video editor that runs in your browser
records.description: Free online & offline video editor, no sign up. Trim, cut, merge and crop MP4, MOV, MKV and WebM in your browser. An offline video cutter for large files - your video never leaves your device

records.name: Otomobilgi.com
records.tagline: An independent car culture platform.
records.description: Otomobil bilgi, haber, ve motor sporları içerikli, 21 dilde yayın yapan bağımsız ve global otomobil platformu.

records.name: Faux Spy
records.tagline: Free AI image & fake profile detector
records.description: Faux Spy is a browser extension for Chrome, Firefox and Edge that tells you whether a photo or video is AI-generated. Right-click any image on Tinder, Instagram, Facebook or any other site and get a verdict with a confidence score in about two seconds.

records.name: Trimp
records.tagline: Create short links, organize campaigns,
records.description: Shorten links and track every click

records.name: GAMO DOCS
records.tagline: 19 free PDF tools, right in your browser
records.description: GAMO DOCS brings 19 free document tools to your browser: merge, split and reorder PDFs, turn images into PDFs, extract text and use OCR. Basic tools process files on your device. Word and Excel conversions recover text, without preserving the original layout.

records.name: tracenest
records.tagline: lightweight health monitoring
records.description: Understand your Node.js API with request analysis, latency insights, public status pages, and lightweight health monitoring.

records.name: Chess Animal
records.tagline: Your chess style as a trading card, from your own games
records.description: Sixteen animals, one of them is you. A free card from your recent Chess.com games, compared with players at your rating.

records.name: Wrought Iron Baluster
records.tagline: Wrought Iron Baluster for Staircase Railing
records.description: Wrought iron work is the technique of transforming wrought and cast iron into works of art. Through iron technology, iron gates, iron guardrail, and indoor iron ornaments can be made. With its traditional art decoration style, wrought iron ornaments are widely used in architectural exterior decoration, interior decoration, furniture decoration and environmental decoration.

records.name: Photo Sprite
records.tagline: Find and organize iPhone photos by asking AI
records.description: Photo Sprite turns natural-language requests into photo selections, album proposals, and cleanup suggestions. Photo analysis runs on your iPhone. The optional AI assistant uses your chosen provider, and every library change waits for your review.

records.name: AI Manga Translator
records.tagline: Translate full manga pages with text back in the bubbles
records.description: Upload a Japanese manga, Korean manhwa or Chinese comic page and get a translated image with the dialogue placed back on the page, instead of copying bubbles one by one. Translate a single page, queue up to 20 pages, convert a CBZ or ZIP chapter, or use the Chrome extension on the page you're reading. 1 credit is 1 page, failed pages are refunded, and one-time packs never expire.
